snake.name: Snake
snake.how: Arrow keys or WASD. Eat, grow, don't bite yourself.

breakout.name: Breakout
breakout.how: Mouse or ←/→ to move, Space or click to launch.

flappy.name: Flappy
flappy.how: Space, ↑ or click to flap through the gaps.

g2048.how: Arrow keys or WASD to slide; equal tiles merge.

dice.title: Dice table
dice.bigsmallHow: Three dice. 4–10 is small, 11–17 is big. Any triple goes to the house. Pays 1:1.
dice.duelHow: You and the dealer roll two dice each. Higher total wins 1:1; a tie gives your bet back.
dice.note: Tiny bets only ({{bets}} coins) and at most ±{{cap}} a day, so nobody gets rich or goes broke. Coins only buy things in Agentville.
dice.offline: The dice table needs the server. Try again when you're back online.

error.daily_limit: That's enough for today — the table opens again tomorrow.
error.rate_limited: Easy — one roll at a time.
error.insufficient_funds: Not enough coins for that bet.
error.server: The server had a problem. Try again.
